headline: Mary Hardin-Baylor leads the ASC in attack and defense
dek: Mary Hardin-Baylor went unbeaten in conference play and finished with thirteen wins, two draws, and three losses across all matches, winning more than Howard Payne, Schreiner, and McMurry combined. Conceding just twelve goals all season gave the program a margin no rival matched.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring drops sharply down the table: Mary Hardin-Baylor's 52 goals exceed the combined totals of Howard Payne and Schreiner, separating the top contenders from the lower half.

wire.line: Member programs won thirteen non-conference matches, drew one, and lost twenty, conceding 74 goals against 53 scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match past its scheduled date carries no published result, and it belongs to McMurry against Southwest.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hardin-Simmons goalkeeper Joel McPherson posted a 0.833 save percentage, making 70 saves while allowing fourteen goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: East Texas Baptist forward Joshua Daley scored ten goals and added four assists from 43 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: McMurry conceded 54 goals across all matches, more than any other program in the ASC, and finished with one win, one draw, and sixteen losses.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Howard Payne goalkeeper Adrian Villa made 99 saves across the season while conceding 40 goals.

last_match.line: Hardin-Simmons arrived on a winning streak that included handing Mary Hardin-Baylor a defeat in the previous outing.
